results.name: Content Completeness
results.reasoning: The generated document describes a fundamentally different architecture than the gold standard: it uses AppRole auth with per-tenant tokens and an orphan-table reconciler, while the gold standard uses Keycloak JWT forwarding with Vault namespaces and per-namespace auth. The generated doc has no Hub backend (for kubeconfigs from hub clusters), no credential migration binary for existing inline fields, no tenant namespace lifecycle management, no Keycloak token exchange for controllers, and misses the complete set of affected resources (Cluster, Hub, IdentityProvider, StorageBackend, Tenant) with their reference field migrations.
